welcomeBody: Your private companion to quit or reduce substances and habits. Everything is stored on your device. You can use the app offline and without an account.
disclaimerAck: I understand that DETOXYA is a wellness and education tool, not medical care, and that in an emergency I should call emergency services.
countryBody: We only use your country to show the right crisis and emergency numbers. You can skip this.
emergencyNote: In your country, the emergency number is {{number}}. Save it in your phone.
goalBody: There is no single right way to recover. Choose what fits today; you can change it later.
goalAbstinenceBody: Stop the substance or habit completely.
goalModerationBody: Reduce use or set clear limits.
goalTaperBody: Cut down with medical support. The app does not give taper schedules.
goalUndecidedBody: Explore reasons and options without committing yet.
substancesTitle: What do you want to quit or reduce?
substancesBody: You can pick several. We use this for the clock, estimated savings and safety notices.
detailsBody: This is only to estimate savings and put your progress in context. You can adjust it anytime.
currencyHint: In {{currency}} or your local currency. Change the numbers if they don't fit.
sexBody: Some questionnaires use different thresholds by biological sex. You can skip: we will use a conservative threshold.
auditCQ1: How often do you drink alcohol?
auditCQ2: How many standard drinks do you have on a typical drinking day? (1 standard drink ≈ one small beer or shot)
auditCQ3: How often do you have 6 or more drinks on one occasion?
cageQ1: Have you ever felt you should cut down on what you use?
cageQ2: Have you ever been annoyed by criticism about your use?
cageQ3: Have you ever felt guilty about your use?
cageQ4: Have you ever used first thing in the morning to feel steady or get going?
flagDaily: Do you use alcohol or benzodiazepines daily?
flagSeizures: Have you had seizures or delirium when stopping?
flagBenzo: Have you taken benzodiazepines daily for more than 4 weeks?
flagOpioid: Do you use opioids (heroin, fentanyl, strong painkillers)?
flagWd: Have you had intense symptoms when trying to stop?
flagPoly: Do you regularly use more than one substance?
flagAlone: Would you be alone if you stopped using?
flagMedical: Do you have a serious diagnosed medical or psychiatric condition?
phqQ1: Little interest or pleasure in doing things
phqQ3: Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much
phqQ4: Feeling tired or having little energy
phqQ6: Feeling bad about yourself or that you are a failure
phqQ8: Moving or speaking slowly, or being fidgety/restless
phqQ9: Thoughts that you would be better off dead or of hurting yourself
pledgeBody: Write yourself a short letter: why are you doing this? Who do you want to see? How do you want to feel? You will read it every morning.
pledgeHint: Stored only on your device. You can edit it in Settings.
